body:
Ha, I fell into this trap as well. `memnew` is not possible here, because it calls the objects' postinitialize, which we need to have control over (via `p_notify_postinitialize`) in this function.
Took me quite a while to debug in an earlier version.
Oh damn, that's subtle! I'd recommend adding a comment with an explanation, as that would've stumped me for a good while too

should this be a static_assert maybe? Or are we trying to "save" gdextension callers here?

I'd love to see a solution where for dynamic callers we crash at runtime, but for static callers we assert at compile time.

NEVERMIND I totally missed that this was the context of the broken MSVC2017 codepath.

Do we need to keep this at all? But that is kind of neither here nor there.
I think `static_assert(false)` doesn't work in this context. MSVC will just trip up even when it's not actually called anywhere (IIRC someone tested this).
I _believe_ this only trips if exceptions are enabled, but it's indeed still necessary in that context (couldn't find a way to suppress the warning)
